data.title: Name --rejected in the instructions an agent reads, on the decision add line itself
data.why: KAD-75: 9 of 10 agents recorded a decision from the init section alone and 0 of 9 used --rejected; 7 wrote the lost option into --why, where rejected-before (DEC-56) cannot read it. The section is the only text every session loads, and its 25-line budget has no room for a line of its own.
data.rejected: A separate line under decision add: the section would be 26 lines, over the budget a test holds it to; Parse the rejected option out of the why prose: guesswork on free text, and the hook would warn on reasons rather than options
